title: Scroll Effects: Parallax & Fade
hints: Each effect is a small formula of the scroll offset.
Pulling down (negative y) stretches; scrolling up (positive y) moves and fades.
jsBridge: Parallax and fade driven by scroll offset, as with `visualEffect` or `scrollTransition`. The web does this with scroll listeners or scroll-driven CSS animations, and SwiftUI gives you the geometry per frame declaratively.

compass.q: CSS scroll-driven animations (`animation-timeline: scroll()`) vs SwiftUI `.scrollTransition`: same idea?
Overscroll (pulling down past the top): what should a stretchy header do?
Reduce Motion is on. What should parallax do (`accessibilityReduceMotion`)?
